subject: Request: confirmation of service gap and credit eligibility for ZenithPay
messages:
From: Anna Torres <anna@zenithpay.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@zenithpay.com
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 22:13:00 -0700
Subject: Production errors and 503 spike — need confirmation for credit request

Hi Mina,

We saw a significant uplift in 503 responses for our Redwood API integration starting ~2027-03-20T21:45:00 PDT through ~2027-03-20T22:02:00 PDT. Our telemetry shows ~18% errors on payment-reconciliation routes which caused a processing backlog and customer-facing retries.

Attached is a small slice of our logs (zenithpay_errors_20270320.log) and a short timeline. We plan to submit a formal credit request if this window qualifies under the SLA. Can you confirm whether Redwood records a service disruption during that period and whether ZenithPay is eligible for a pro-rata credit?

Thanks — we appreciate a quick confirmation so we can proceed with procurement.

—Anna
Anna Torres
Sr. Platform Engineer, ZenithPay
anna@zenithpay.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Anna Torres <anna@zenithpay.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 22:49:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production errors and 503 spike — need confirmation for credit request

Hi Anna — thanks for the heads up and for sending logs. I’ve looped in Vivek (SRE) and Marissa (Customer Ops) to validate the observability window and confirm credit eligibility.

Quick asks while we triage:
- Can you confirm whether those requests were routed to our hosted region us-west-2 or a dedicated pool?
- If available, please include a small sample request id (x-request-id) for a failed request so we can trace at the edge.

We’ll come back with an initial verification within a few hours and an ETA for the postmortem.

Best,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Account Manager — Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Anna Torres <anna@zenithpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 02:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production errors and 503 spike — need confirmation for credit request

Hi all — quick update from SRE: our infra alerting shows a transient spike in 503s starting 2027-03-20T21:44:30-07:00 through 2027-03-20T22:01:50-07:00 tied to a brief autoscaler latency during a regional rollout. We’re pulling full edge traces and will correlate with Anna’s x-request-ids once provided.

Preliminarily, this looks like an availability gap that could meet the SLA interruption definition (greater than 1% error rate sustained for >5 minutes on routed requests). I don’t want to pre-commit final credit amounts until logs match exactly, but ZenithPay should be eligible for a pro-rata credit under our hosted SLA.

Next steps:
- Anna: if you can send one or two representative x-request-id values, we’ll attach the matched traces.
- Marissa and Mina: can you start the credit evaluation ticket (REF: ZP-4921-SLA) and request the signed credit request form? I’ve added the exact timestamps we saw above to the ticket description.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior SRE — Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Anna Torres <anna@zenithpay.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@zenithpay.com
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 07:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production errors and 503 spike — need confirmation for credit request

Thanks Vivek — attaching two request ids we captured: x-request-id=ZP-req-8b9c and x-request-id=ZP-req-8b9d. We were on the hosted plan in us-west-2 for these requests.

I’ve also attached our completed request_for_credit_form.pdf; please let us know if anything else is required for processing. We’d like the credit processed before our next billing cycle.

—Anna

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Anna Torres <anna@zenithpay.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production errors and 503 spike — need confirmation for credit request

Hi Anna — thanks for the ids and form. We’ve verified the traces for x-request-id=ZP-req-8b9c and ZP-req-8b9d; both map to the 2027-03-20T21:44:30-2027-03-20T22:01:50 window Vivek mentioned. Based on the error volume and the SLA terms for hosted customers, ZenithPay meets the threshold for a pro-rata credit.

What to expect next:
- I’ve opened ticket REF: ZP-4921-SLA-PRORA with Finance; estimated credit calculation and approval in 3–5 business days.
- We’ll produce a short postmortem (root cause + mitigation) within 7 business days and share it with your ops team.
- If you need the credit sooner for procurement reasons, we can escalate to Billing leadership — let Mina know and she’ll coordinate.

Appreciate your patience; we’ll keep you posted.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
